home.title: Home Assistant Secrets
home.description: Manage and synchronise your secrets from 1Password to Home Assistant

serviceAccountWarning.title: 1Password service account token required
serviceAccountWarning.description: Add OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN in the add-on configuration to start syncing secrets. Until then, nothing is written to secrets.yaml.

groups.title: Event Groups
groups.description: Combine secrets to receive a single Home Assistant event when any secret in the group updates.

modal.nameDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens. Used in the event name.
modal.eventHint: Event fired when any selected secret changes

groups.emptyBody: A group fires <event></event> whenever any of its secrets changes - handy for restarting one integration when its credentials rotate.

delete.title: Delete group “{name}”?
delete.body: Automations listening for <event></event> will stop firing. {count, plural, =1 {The secret in it is not affected.} other {The # secrets in it are not affected.}}

rateLimits.title: 1Password Rate Limits
rateLimits.description: Monitor your 1Password service account API usage and limits.
rateLimits.noDataYet: Usage is fetched automatically after the first successful sync with 1Password.

daily.title: Daily requests
daily.description: Total API requests per day, all service accounts combined

hourlyReads.title: Hourly reads
hourlyReads.description: Read operations per hour, this service account

warning.title: Approaching the 1Password rate limit
warning.description: {limits} are above 90% of the limit. Syncing pauses when the limit is reached.

info.title: About rate limits
info.description: 1Password enforces rate limits on service account API usage to ensure system stability. These limits vary by account tier.
info.readOnlyNote: This add-on only reads data from 1Password.

empty.title: No secrets found in secrets.yaml
empty.body: Add keys to secrets.yaml (e.g. mqtt_password: "") and reference them with !secret. They'll appear here on the next sync, ready to link to 1Password.

modal.searchLabel: Search by title, username or vault
modal.otpHidden: One-time password fields can't be written to secrets.yaml and are hidden.
modal.syncsNext: Value syncs on the next run

broken.banner: {count, plural, =1 {1 secret lost its 1Password link} other {# secrets lost their 1Password link}}
broken.bannerBody: 1Password can't find the item or field they point to. secrets.yaml keeps the last synced value until you re-link them.
broken.item: “{item}” was deleted or moved out of {vault}
broken.vault: The service account can't read the {vault} vault

groupName.invalid: Group name must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
groupName.tooShort: Group name must be at least 2 characters
groupName.tooLong: Group name must be at most 50 characters

info.title: Home Assistant Events
info.description: This add-on fires custom events you can use as automation triggers. Every event includes a timestamp field; read the payload with trigger.event.data.

examples.title: Automation examples
examples.restartAddon: Restart an add-on when its secret changes
examples.notifyGroup: Notify when a group of secrets is updated

secretsSynced.trigger: Fired after every successful synchronisation operation. Contains the list of changed secrets and groups.

secretWritten.trigger: Fired for each individual secret written to secrets.yaml during synchronisation.

secretAssigned.trigger: Fired when a secret is linked to a 1Password item through the UI.

secretUnassigned.trigger: Fired when a secret is unlinked from its 1Password item.

secretSkipToggled.trigger: Fired when a secret's visibility (hidden/shown) is toggled in the UI.

itemRefreshed.trigger: Fired when a 1Password item is manually refreshed, affecting all linked secrets.

groupUpdated.trigger: Fired when any secret in a group is updated. {name} is replaced with your group name.

error.trigger: Fired when any error occurs during synchronisation, API calls, or operations.

toast.syncComplete: Sync complete - {count, plural, =0 {no changes} =1 {1 secret updated} other {# secrets updated}}
